title: Unescaped account profile content in shell
reproducible_evidence: Profile name, role, position, department and error values reached innerHTML without HTML encoding. Original source contained raw ${user.name} templates.
impact: Stored markup injection in an authenticated account; executing payload depends on attacker control of a field.
recommended_action: Use context-aware escapeHtml for every affected interpolation and retry handlers through addEventListener.
validation: Offline HTML escaping and template inspection

title: Private backups and development material packaged
reproducible_evidence: Original ZIP contains .dev.vars, .git contents, SQL backup files and user-seeding scripts; no credentials or personal records reproduced in the audit.
impact: Unnecessary risk when source ZIP is shared; actual secret exposure NOT established.
recommended_action: Strict source allowlist, exclude backups, historical content, .dev.vars, and node_modules.
validation: Inspect release ZIP and verify exclusion of paths

title: Development identity override trusted deployment flag alone
reproducible_evidence: Original bypass activated with APP_ENV=local plus DEV_USER_EMAIL, regardless of request host.
impact: A mistakenly deployed APP_ENV value could bypass Cloudflare Access.
recommended_action: Require APP_ENV local AND URL loopback hostname, keep Access JWT verified for public hosts.
validation: localhost vs public-host tokenless auth tests

title: Task state changes depended on stale read
reproducible_evidence: Original task transition updates matched only id; two actors could act on the same read status.
impact: Duplicate notifications/activity or wrong state after overlapping operations.
recommended_action: Optimistic status/version guard in D1 batch; DB trigger enforcing legal transition graph.
validation: Synthetic SQLite and real HTTP request stale-operation tests

title: Request approval, rejection and conversion race
reproducible_evidence: Status-changing UPDATE previously matched id only; withdrawal/archive/approval checks were earlier reads.
impact: Duplicate/conflicting status, audit and notification events; conversion errors.
recommended_action: D1 BEFORE UPDATE state triggers abort conflicting batches; preserve UNIQUE source_request_id.
validation: 10 actual-API SQL integration tests and 12 direct SQLite checks

title: Sole active Lead could be removed between check and update
reproducible_evidence: Separate last-Lead count query and mutation opened a race for simultaneous administrators.
impact: Organization can become administratively locked out.
recommended_action: Add database guard that blocks demotion/inactivation of final active Lead.
validation: Synthetic SQLite last-Lead tests and real API forbidden role mutation

title: Staging and production environments not isolated in config
reproducible_evidence: Only one D1 binding points to a database named dsc-oms-staging; no named production environment is defined.
impact: A production deployment command could target staging resources or incorrectly share data.
recommended_action: Define explicit environments with separate DB IDs and verified Access policies; manual approval.
validation: Dry-run deployments and independent D1 binding verification

title: Public health endpoint returned user count
reproducible_evidence: Original unauthenticated /api/health queried user count.
impact: Discloses organizational membership volume and uses an unnecessary count query.
recommended_action: Use SELECT 1 readiness check without user totals; return 503 if D1 unavailable.
validation: Unauthenticated HTTP tests of public endpoint

title: Template tests did not exercise application
reproducible_evidence: Original Vitest checked /message and /random starter endpoints absent from current app.
impact: False confidence and no regression safety.
recommended_action: Replace placeholders; add Node built-in runner and in-memory real-SQL route tests.
validation: 36 Node tests plus 12 Python SQLite tests (see latest validation)

title: Social profile links accepted legacy unsafe protocols
reproducible_evidence: Dynamic profile URLs were inserted into anchor contexts; URL scheme not consistently normalized on display.
impact: Potential javascript: link execution or hostile external link if legacy database values exist.
recommended_action: Validate protocols as HTTP(S) before constructing anchors.
validation: safeExternalUrl rejects javascript:, data: and relative URLs

title: CSV formula protection missed obfuscated leading whitespace
reproducible_evidence: Original guard checked only the first character and missed strings such as space followed by =.
impact: Spreadsheet formula execution when opened by staff in a supporting spreadsheet application.
recommended_action: Reject/neutralize formula leading characters even after whitespace/BOM/zero width.
validation: CSV tests with synthetic formula payloads

title: No explicit mutation origin enforcement in API
reproducible_evidence: Authenticated mutations relied on Cloudflare Access protection and browser cookie behavior, with no API-level Origin check.
impact: CSRF depends on Cloudflare Access deployment and cookie policy. Exploit not demonstrated.
recommended_action: Reject explicit cross-origin mutations; no-store API responses; static CSP/headers.
validation: Cross-origin POST with origin + sec-fetch-site returns 403

title: Defined Approved task state never reached by approval
reproducible_evidence: approveTask deliberately writes Completed from For Review; Approved is still in schema and requested lifecycle.
impact: Misleading terminology for members and reporting; introducing an Approved stage would change behavior.
recommended_action: Product decision: keep legacy direct completion or formally add Approved then Completed transition.
validation: Explicit workflow acceptance tests after approval policy decision

title: All active tasks visible across departments
reproducible_evidence: Function canViewTask explicitly returns true for any non-Archived task, marked OMS_ORGANIZATION_TASK_VISIBILITY.
impact: If tasks include confidential data, active-task read scope may be excessive; the intent may instead be transparency.
recommended_action: Confirm organization privacy policy; restrict fields/rows only if policy requires, with role tests.
validation: Run consented access matrix including confidential task fixtures

title: Sequential per-project aggregate lookups
reproducible_evidence: listProjects loops over projects and awaits getProjectAggregate one by one.
impact: Latency and extra D1 reads grow with project count.
recommended_action: Aggregate with batched queries or keyed bulk loading; benchmark first.
validation: Seed 10/100/1000 synthetic projects and compare D1 read count

title: Task DTO computes permissions with additional queries
reproducible_evidence: DTO permission evaluation awaits project manager/member checks per task; listTasks builds DTOs per record.
impact: Excess reads and UI latency for large task lists.
recommended_action: Preload role/project membership once per page and paginate; preserve permission logic.
validation: Count D1 statements before and after on generated fixtures

title: Multiple notification controls and theme UI injected
reproducible_evidence: Header runtime independently adds a notification bell and theme buttons in addition to app shell.
impact: Duplicated controls and inconsistent focus/accessibility on smaller screens.
recommended_action: Consolidate after browser snapshots verify intended layout; one duplicate notification menu removed.
validation: Browser desktop and mobile behavior, keyboard focus checks

title: Mojibake in navigation glyphs and request placeholders
reproducible_evidence: Corrupted UTF-8 text showed gibberish instead of symbols.
impact: Visual credibility and legibility.
recommended_action: Replace corrupted strings with proper Unicode glyphs.
validation: Node regression inspection + JS syntax check

title: No browser-based cross-device and accessibility verification
reproducible_evidence: Static source review is possible; Playwright/browser run was not executed in this Linux working environment.
impact: Unknown keyboard, focus, mobile layout and dark/light regressions.
recommended_action: Install browser runner in a clean environment and exercise user journeys.
validation: Playwright smoke flow at 375/768/1440 widths and axe scans

title: Backup/restore and Access configuration not verified live
reproducible_evidence: Offline ZIP does not prove live Cloudflare Access policies, D1 PITR status, restore readiness, or separate secrets.
impact: Data recovery and public exposure risk if configuration differs from assumptions.
recommended_action: Human-run staging restore drill and Cloudflare Access policy review before deploy.
validation: Staging restore drill, token tests and deployed smoke checks

title: Repeated HTML escape helpers and layered CSS overrides
reproducible_evidence: Multiple local helpers duplicate same transform; six linked stylesheets have override layering.
impact: Divergent escaping behavior and hard-to-debug styles.
recommended_action: Incrementally centralize safe rendering and remove only proven-dead CSS.
validation: Visual regression screenshots and template unit tests

title: Template HTML rendering across 28 JS modules remains broader review scope
reproducible_evidence: Many components use innerHTML. Targeted shell fields and social links were fixed; no exhaustive taint analysis of every template slot or browser exploit test completed.
impact: Residual XSS cannot be ruled out from static/source sampling.
recommended_action: Taint-review every interpolated user field by HTML, attribute, or URL context; add browser attack fixtures.
validation: Automated template-slot checks and browser input injection E2E
resolution_status: Partially mitigated / broader template audit remains

title: List endpoints do not show consistent pagination
reproducible_evidence: Routes return complete task/request lists; no limit/offset in these two paths.
impact: Large datasets can increase Worker time, D1 reads and DOM size.
recommended_action: Add scoped cursor paging and server-side filters after measuring datasets.
validation: Synthetic load benchmark for 100/1000/10000 tasks

title: JWT live JWKS/certificate lifecycle and Cloudflare policy
reproducible_evidence: jose jwtVerify with issuer/audience and a cached remote JWK set is implemented; no real signed Access JWT or network JWKS rotation fixture tested.
impact: Live Access outage/policy drift behavior remains unverified.
recommended_action: Staging signed token tests for expiry, audience and rotation; keep fail closed.
validation: Integration with representative JWKS and controlled token expiry

title: Unescaped user/department fields in Create Project dialog
reproducible_evidence: Original interpolation of department.name, user.name, user.id and attribute IDs directly into overlay.innerHTML
impact: Stored-XSS if a hostile field value reaches dialog
recommended_action: Shared context-aware HTML escaping for all data-derived slots
validation: Node sink regression plus Chromium component injection at three widths

title: Project dialog missing keyboard focus lifecycle
reproducible_evidence: Old modal lacked role dialog, Escape dismissal and initial focus
impact: Keyboard and screen-reader navigation impaired
recommended_action: Reusable modal focus trap with ARIA attributes and return focus
validation: Chromium DOM smoke 375px/768px/1440px
